questions.q: In LOCAL_NED, climbing 10 m means Z = …
What happens if the companion stops sending velocity targets?
options: It keeps flying at the last velocity
It cuts the motors and falls
questions.explain: GUID_TIMEOUT (3 s by default) is a protection you rely on, not work around.

questions.q: At what rate should you send velocity targets?
questions.explain: Within the timeout, even if the target has not changed.

questions.q: The pilot switched the mode from GUIDED to LOITER. What should the code do?
options: Switch back to GUIDED with a command
questions.explain: The code must respect the pilot.

questions.q: The vehicle stops without reaching the target. Likely cause?
options: The geofence or the WPNAV_* limits
The velocity loop P in GUIDED is too low
questions.explain: It is an FC protection; check FENCE_* and the messages.

questions.q: Where do you run offboard code first?
options: On the bench with props on
questions.explain: The same code, the same port, only the address differs.
